 25540: /* Resolves the C result type of a sizeof/alignof expression operand strictly: every
 25541:    sub-operand must resolve through a mapped entity, literal, cast, or call before any
 25542:    type is combined, and binary operators apply the usual arithmetic conversions (so
 25543:    narrow operands promote to int and mixed widths take the wider side). Returning
 25544:    false defers to the older per-shape paths and ultimately the caller's fallback; a
 25545:    guessed type must never come out of this function, because the guessed size folds
 25546:    silently into the program (the 2026-08-08 array-bound incident, and the same
 25547:    defect shape in function bodies). */
 25548: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt_depth(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId* type_out, u32 remaining_depth, bool promote_bit_fields)
 25549: {
 25550:     // This resolver is a speculative type query: false lets the caller use
 25551:     // the ordinary expression paths.  Bound its recursive precedence walk so
 25552:     // adversarially deep, otherwise-valid expressions cannot exhaust the host
 25553:     // stack in sanitizer/fuzz configurations, whose instrumented frames are
 25554:     // substantially larger than Release frames.
 25555:     if (!remaining_depth)
 25556:     {
 25557:         return false;
 25558:     }
 25559:     remaining_depth -= 1;
 25560:     // GNU __extension__ is a diagnostic-only marker on the expression that
 25561:     // follows it; it contributes no value and no type of its own, so strip it
 25562:     // the same way a redundant parenthesis is stripped, and keep stripping
 25563:     // both until neither applies.  musl's <complex.h> spells `I` as

 31434: {
 31435:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 31436:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 31437:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
 31438:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION);
 31439:     bool unwind = false;
 31440:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN)
 31441:     {
 31442:         if (frame->as.expression.start >= frame->as.expression.end || frame->as.expression.end > builder->preprocess.token_count)
 31443:         {
 31444:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31445:             return;
 31446:         }
 31447:         frame->as.expression.value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 31448:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 31449:     }

 31451:     {
 31452:         if (!machine->child_result.success)

 31455:             return;

 31462:     {

 31464:         // Lower the assignment through the statement machine and provide the
 31465:         // discarded value expected by the surrounding comma/expression walk.

 31472:         if (frame->as.expression.value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 31473:         {
 31474:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);

 32979: /* The backward twin of c_parse_c23_attribute_at: true when a C23 attribute
 32980:    specifier ends at `index - 1`, with `start_out` receiving its opening '['.
 32981:    Every scan that skips one reads forwards, because a forward skip is a loop
 32982:    step; the label proof below is the one question in the frontend asked from
 32983:    the far side, and `[[maybe_unused]] again:` puts a ']' where it expects a
 32984:    statement boundary. The walk mirrors the forward one -- depth over
 32985:    brackets, closing on the '[[' that is not nested -- because the contents
 32986:    are a balanced token sequence that may carry brackets of its own. */
 32987: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_c23_attribute_ends_before(CPreprocessResult const* preprocess, u32 body_start, u32 index, u32* start_out)
 32988: {
 32989:     if (index < body_start + 4 || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess->tokens[index - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) ||
 32990:         !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess->tokens[index - 2], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))
 32991:     {
 32992:         return false;
 32993:     }
 32994:     u32 depth = 0;
 32995:     for (u32 scan = index - 3; scan > body_start; scan -= 1)
 32996:     {
 32997:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess->tokens[scan], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))
 32998:         {
 32999:             depth += 1;
 33000:         }
 33001:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess->tokens[scan], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 33002:         {
 33003:             if (depth)
 33004:             {
 33005:                 depth -= 1;
 33006:             }
 33007:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess->tokens[scan - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 33008:             {
 33009:                 *start_out = scan - 1;
 33010:                 return true;
 33011:             }
 33012:             else
 33013:             {
 33014:                 return false;
 33015:             }
 33016:         }
 33017:     }
 33018:     return false;
 33019: }

 33060: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_matching_delimiter(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 open, u32 end, CPunctuator opening, CPunctuator closing)
 33061: {
 33062:     // The shape sidecar answers this whole query 64 tokens at a time; the row
 33063:     // scan below stays as the definition for a stream that carries no
 33064:     // sidecar, for a host without the wide compares, and as the reference the
 33065:     // windowed kernel is held to.
 33066: #if BUSTER_C_LEX_COMPACT
 33067:     CTokenShape const* shapes = c_preprocess_token_shapes(&preprocess);
 33068:     if (BUSTER_LIKELY(shapes != 0))
 33069:     {
 33070:         return c_shape_matching_delimiter(shapes, open, end, opening, closing);
 33071:     }
 33072: #endif
 33073:     // The pair is loop-invariant, so it becomes one set the scan tests each
 33074:     // token against: the two chained compares per token were two dependent
 33075:     // branches, and the delimiters themselves are a small minority of the
 33076:     // range being scanned.
 33077:     u64 delimiters = C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(opening) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(closing);
 33078:     u32 depth = 0;
 33079:     for (u32 index = open; index < end; index += 1)
 33080:     {
 33081:         u8 punctuator = preprocess.tokens[index].punctuator;
 33082:         if (c_punctuator_in_set(punctuator, delimiters))
 33083:         {
 33084:             if (punctuator == opening)
 33085:             {
 33086:                 depth += 1;
 33087:             }
 33088:             else
 33089:             {
 33090:                 if (!depth)
 33091:                 {
 33092:                     return UINT32_MAX;
 33093:                 }
 33094:                 depth -= 1;
 33095:                 if (!depth)
 33096:                 {
 33097:                     return index;
 33098:                 }
 33099:             }
 33100:         }
 33101:     }
 33102:     return UINT32_MAX;
 33103: }

 41651: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId root_type, u8* bytes, u64 byte_count,
 41652:                                                          IrGlobalRelocation* relocations, u32* relocation_count, u32 relocation_capacity);

 41654: // The scalar leaves of an aggregate initializer, classified before they are
 41655: // folded.  Almost every leaf of a large table is one number -- the generated
 41656: // instruction metadata is arrays of small integer records -- and the general
 41657: // folder (c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes_legacy) prices each at a task
 41658: // array, a compound-literal probe, a query frame, the shunting-yard
 41659: // evaluator, a cast and a byte loop.  A leaf whose tokens are exactly a
 41660: // number, a signed number, a character constant or an identifier naming an
 41661: // integer constant, landing in an integer, boolean, enum or float member
 41662: // that is not a bit-field, is folded here
 41663: // instead: the same literal routines and typing rules the evaluator uses
 41664: // (c_ir_integer_literal_type, c_ir_float_literal_value,
 41665: // c_ir_decode_character_value), the evaluator's unary `+`/`-`
 41666: // (c_ir_constant_apply_unary) and its cast (c_ir_constant_cast), then one
 41667: // little-endian store of the member's size.  The class is one byte decided
 41668: // from the token kinds and the member's kind alone; an arm that cannot
 41669: // reproduce the evaluator's answer -- a literal no type holds, a 128-bit
 41670: // operand, an imaginary suffix -- declines, and the leaf takes the general
 41671: // folder, so every refusal and its message stay exactly what they were.
 41672: // A big-endian target keeps the byte loop: only the little-endian store is
 41673: // written here.
 41674: typedef enum CIrInitializerLeafClass
 41675: {
 41676:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_OTHER,
 41677:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER,
 41678:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT,
 41679:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_FLOAT_TO_FLOAT,
 41680:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER,
 41681:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER,
 41682: } CIrInitializerLeafClass;
 41683: 
 41684: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_identifier(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, CIrConstantValue* result);
 41685: 
 41686: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u8 c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_class(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end)
 41687: {
 41688:     u8 leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_OTHER;
 41689:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
 41690:     u32 count = end - start;
 41691:     bool signed_prefix =
 41692:         count == 2 && (c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS));
 41693:     if ((count == 1 || signed_prefix) && builder->program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE)
 41694:     {
 41695:         CToken literal = tokens[end - 1];
 41696:         u64 size = child->layout.size;
 41697:         // The sizes one u64 of bits fills: a wider member takes the general
 41698:         // evaluator and the two-limb byte writer.
 41699:         bool integer_child = (child->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || child->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || child->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM) &&
 41700:                              (size == 1 || size == 2 || size == 4 || size == 8);
 41701:         // binary16, f32 and f64: the x87 element has its own folder ahead of
 41702:         // the general one, and any other width is stored through the general
 41703:         // folder's own conversion.
 41704:         bool float_child = child->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && ((child->bit_width == 16 && size == 2) || (child->bit_width == 32 && size == 4) ||
 41705:                                                             (child->bit_width == 64 && size == 8));
 41706:         if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 41707:         {
 41708:             bool floating = c_number_is_float(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, literal));
 41709:             if (integer_child && !floating)
 41710:             {
 41711:                 leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER;
 41712:             }
 41713:             else if (float_child)
 41714:             {
 41715:                 leaf_class = floating ? C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_FLOAT_TO_FLOAT : C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
 41716:             }
 41717:         }
 41718:         else if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL && integer_child)
 41719:         {
 41720:             leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER;
 41721:         }
 41722:         else if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && integer_child)
 41723:         {
 41724:             leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER;
 41725:         }
 41726:     }
 41727:     return leaf_class;
 41728: }

 41730: // `size` bytes of `bits`, least significant first: what
 41731: // c_ir_constant_store_unit_bits writes for a little-endian target and a
 41732: // member no wider than the bits.  Spelled per size so the stores merge.
 41733: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(u8* bytes, u64 size, u64 bits)
 41734: {
 41735:     switch (size)
 41736:     {
 41737:     case 1:
 41738:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
 41739:         break;
 41740:     case 2:
 41741:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
 41742:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
 41743:         break;
 41744:     case 4:

 41754:         bytes[3] = (u8)(bits >> 24);
 41755:         bytes[4] = (u8)(bits >> 32);
 41756:         bytes[5] = (u8)(bits >> 40);
 41757:         bytes[6] = (u8)(bits >> 48);
 41758:         bytes[7] = (u8)(bits >> 56);

 41765: // The evaluator's unary `+`/`-` on an integer constant of `*type`
 41766: // (c_ir_constant_apply_unary): a boolean or narrow operand is promoted to
 41767: // int first -- no literal type is that narrow, but the rule is kept so the
 41768: // arm and the evaluator cannot disagree -- and the result is masked to the
 41769: // operand's width.  False for the 128-bit operand, whose wide negate stays
 41770: // with the evaluator.
 41771: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType** type, u64* integer, bool negative)
 41772: {
 41773:     IrType* operand = *type;
 41774:     if (operand->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || (operand->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && operand->bit_width < 32))
 41775:     {
 41776:         operand = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->s32_type);
 41777:     }
 41778:     bool applied = operand && !(operand->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && operand->bit_width == 128);
 41779:     if (applied)
 41780:     {
 41781:         u64 value = negative ? 0 - *integer : *integer;
 41782:         *integer = value & c_ir_integer_type_mask(operand);
 41783:         *type = operand;
 41784:     }
 41785:     return applied;
 41786: }

 41788: // An integer constant of `literal_type` stored into the integer member
 41789: // `child`: c_ir_constant_cast replays a signed source's sign bit before the
 41790: // target mask. A boolean tests nonzero before that narrowing.
 41791: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(IrType* child, IrType* literal_type, u64 integer, u8* bytes)
 41792: {
 41793:     u64 value = literal_type->is_signed ? (u64)c_ir_integer_signed_value(integer, literal_type) : integer;
 41794:     u64 converted = child->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ? value != 0 : value & c_ir_integer_type_mask(child);
 41795:     c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(bytes, child->layout.size, converted);
 41796: }

 41798: // A floating value stored into the binary16, f32 or f64 member `child`: the
 41799: // cast rounds at the member's own precision (c_ir_constant_cast), and the
 41800: // folder writes that value's bits.
 41801: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_store_float_leaf(IrType* child, f64 floating, u8* bytes)
 41802: {
 41803:     u64 bits = 0;
 41804:     if (child->bit_width == 16)
 41805:     {
 41806:         bits = child->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_bits_from_f64(floating) : c_ir_float16_bits_from_f64(floating);
 41807:     }
 41808:     else if (child->bit_width == 32)
 41809:     {
 41810:         f32 narrowed = (f32)(f64)(f32)floating;
 41811:         u32 narrowed_bits = 0;
 41812:         memcpy(&narrowed_bits, &narrowed, sizeof(narrowed_bits));
 41813:         bits = narrowed_bits;
 41814:     }
 41815:     else
 41816:     {
 41817:         memcpy(&bits, &floating, sizeof(bits));
 41818:     }
 41819:     c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(bytes, child->layout.size, bits);
 41820: }

 44138:                     success = true;
 44139:                 }
 44140:                 else if (target->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
 44141:                 {
 44142:                     // C 6.3.1.2: compare to zero before any truncation. This
 44143:                     // includes floating fractions, NaNs, pointers and i128's
 44144:                     // high limb; a one-bit integer mask cannot implement it.
 44145:                     success = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER || source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT ||

 44151:                 {

 44153:                               (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(source_type)));
 44154:                     bool wide = target->bit_width > 64 || (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT && source_type && source_type->bit_width > 64);
 44155:                     if (success && wide)
 44156:                     {
 44157:                         success = c_ir_constant_wide_float_cast(&source, source_type, target, result);
 44158:                     }
 44159:                     else if (success)
 44160:                     {
 44161:                         u32 precision = target->bit_width == 16   ? (target->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? 8u : 11u)
 44162:                                         : target->bit_width == 32 ? 24u
 44163:                                                                   : 53u;
 44164:                         f64 floating = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT ? source.floating
 44165:                                                                          : c_ir_constant_integer_to_float(&source, source_type, precision);
 44166:                         // A floating source still rounds at the destination's
 44167:                         // precision; the integer path has already rounded once.
 44168:                         // binary16 rounds from the binary64 carrier in both
 44169:                         // cases: every value it can hold is exact there, so the
 44170:                         // integer path's own rounding cannot have moved a
 44171:                         // result across a half-precision boundary first.
 44172:                         if (target->bit_width == 16)
 44173:                             floating = target->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_round(floating)
 44174:                                                                                         : c_ir_float16_round(floating);
 44175:                         else if (target->bit_width == 32)
 44176:                             floating = (f64)(f32)floating;

 44178:                     }
 44179:                 }
 44180:                 else if (c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(target))
 44181:                 {
 44182:                     if (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT)
 44183:                     {
 44184:                         CIrWideInteger integer = {0};
 44185:                         success = source_type && source_type->bit_width > 64
 44186:                                       ? c_ir_constant_wide_float_to_integer(&source, source_type, target, &integer)
 44187:                                       : c_ir_constant_float_to_integer(source.floating, target, &integer);
 44188:                         if (success)
 44189:                         {
 44190:                             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(target_type, integer.low & c_ir_integer_type_mask(target));
 44191:                             result->integer_high = target->bit_width == 128 ? integer.high : 0;
 44192:                         }
 44193:                     }
 44194:                     else
 44195:                     {
 44196:                         success = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER ||
 44197:                                   (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && source.symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && source.addend == 0);
 44198:                         if (success)
 44199:                         {
 44200:                             u64 integer = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER ? source.integer : 0;
 44201:                             IrType* source_integer_type = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER ? source_type : 0;
 44202:                             // Replay a negative narrow source's sign before the
 44203:                             // target mask. Narrowing still discards the high bits.
 44204:                             if (source_integer_type && source_integer_type->is_signed)
 44205:                                 integer = (u64)c_ir_integer_signed_value(integer, source_integer_type);
 44206:                             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(target_type, integer & c_ir_integer_type_mask(target));
 44207:                             if (target->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && target->bit_width == 128 && source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER)

 44236: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_apply_unary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CConditionalOperator operation, IrTypeId cast_type,
 44237:                                                     CIrConstantValue* value)
 44238: {
 44239:     bool success = false;
 44240:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_CAST)
 44241:     {
 44242:         CIrConstantValue cast = {0};
 44243:         success = c_ir_constant_cast(builder, value, cast_type, &cast);
 44244:         if (success)
 44245:             *value = cast;
 44246:     }
 44247:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_ADDRESS_OF)
 44248:     {
 44249:         if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE)
 44250:         {
 44251:             IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, value->type);
 44252:             success = pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 44253:             if (success)
 44254:             {
 44255:                 value->type = pointer_type;
 44256:                 value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER;
 44257:             }
 44258:         }
 44259:     }
 44260:     else if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 44261:     {
 44262:         success = true;
 44263:     }
 44264:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DEREFERENCE)
 44265:     {
 44266:         IrType* pointer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 44267:         success = value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && pointer && pointer->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER;
 44268:         if (success)
 44269:         {
 44270:             value->type = pointer->element_type;
 44271:             value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
 44272:         }
 44273:     }
 44274:     else if (c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, value))
 44275:     {
 44276:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 44277:         if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_NOT)
 44278:         {
 44279:             *value = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->s32_type, !c_ir_constant_truth(builder, value));
 44280:             success = true;
 44281:         }
 44282:         else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 44283:         {
 44284:             if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 44285:             {
 44286:                 if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS)
 44287:                 {
 44288:                     if (type->bit_width > 64) value->integer_high ^= type->bit_width == 80 ? UINT64_C(0x8000) : UINT64_C(0x8000000000000000);
 44289:                     else value->floating = -value->floating;
 44290:                 }
 44291:                 success = true;
 44292:             }
 44293:             else if (c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(type))
 44294:             {
 44295:                 // All three unary integer operators promote. Cast the value,
 44296:                 // not just its type, so signed char/short retain their sign.
 44297:                 IrTypeId promoted = c_ir_constant_common_type(builder, value->type, value->type);
 44298:                 success = c_ir_constant_cast(builder, value, promoted, value);
 44299:                 if (success)
 44300:                 {
 44301:                     type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 44302:                     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS)
 44303:                     {
 44304:                         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width == 128)
 44305:                         {
 44306:                             CIrWideInteger negated = c_ir_wide_negate((CIrWideInteger){.low = value->integer, .high = value->integer_high});
 44307:                             value->integer = negated.low;
 44308:                             value->integer_high = negated.high;
 44309:                         }
 44310:                         else
 44311:                             value->integer = 0 - value->integer;
 44312:                     }
 44313:                     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 44314:                     {
 44315:                         value->integer = ~value->integer;
 44316:                         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width == 128)
 44317:                             value->integer_high = ~value->integer_high;
 44318:                     }
 44319:                     value->integer &= c_ir_integer_type_mask(type);
 44320:                 }
 44321:             }
 44322:         }
 44323:     }
 44324:     return success;
 44325: }

 47300: // Answers the alignment the specifiers in [alignment_start, alignment_count)
 47301: // ask for: the maximum of `natural_alignment` and every request. The sizeof
 47302: // folding in c_parse_layout_alignment_specifiers walks the same records and
 47303: // must reach the same number.
 47304: //
 47305: // A GNU `aligned(N)` only ever raises, so an N the type already satisfies is
 47306: // exactly the no-op the maximum computes on its own -- a header defending
 47307: // itself with `aligned(2)` on an already 4-aligned member keeps its layout.
 47308: // `_Alignas` carries the opposite rule, since C requires a declaration's
 47309: // alignment to be at least the natural one, and Clang measures the largest
 47310: // request in the declaration rather than each one: `_Alignas(2)
 47311: // __attribute__((aligned(8))) int` is accepted, `_Alignas(2) int` is not.
 47312: //
 47313: // A rejected run still fills *alignment_out with the usable maximum, so the
 47314: // caller can finish the layout and report `*rejection_out` against the
 47315: // attribute instead of leaving a type nothing downstream can name.
 47316: //
 47317: // `requested_out`, when asked for, receives the largest alignment any of the
 47318: // records *asks* for, before it is merged with the declared type's natural
 47319: // alignment. Only the bit-field placement rule needs that raw number: GNU
 47320: // `aligned(N)` starts a bit-field at the next multiple of N bytes even when N
 47321: // is below the declared type's own alignment, while every other reader of a
 47322: // request only ever raises with it. Zero means no record resolved.

     1: // Parsing and semantic analysis, the second stage of the frontend. Two
     2: // passes over the preprocessed token stream, entered through c_parse_ast and
     3: // c_analyze_semantics at the bottom of the file (c_parse runs both):
     4: // - c_parse_ast is one linear scan that splits the stream into top-level
     5: //   CParserDeclaration records â token extents, the name token, the body
     6: //   range, and typedef/constexpr/variadic flags â by delimiter counting
     7: //   alone. It builds no tree; every later consumer re-walks token ranges.
     8: //   The same top-level/body walks validate active integer token spellings,
     9: //   including unevaluated operands, before any type-only shortcut can hide one.
    10: //   A function body is split into statements the same way, and the one fact
    11: //   kept about them is the token range of each _Static_assert statement
    12: //   (CParserStaticAssert), which c_parse_bind_function_static_asserts
    13: //   checks against the block scopes the body binder creates. Body splitting
    14: //   reuses one depth-sized CParserBodyFrames vector; published declarations
    15: //   and assertion ranges remain owned by the translation-unit arena.
    16: //   One record is one declarator, not one declaration: a comma-separated
    17: //   list is split into a record per declarator, each keeping the shared
    18: //   specifiers in token_start/token_count and its own declarator segment in
    19: //   declarator_start/declarator_count.
    20: // - c_analyze_semantics sizes its tables from a token census
    21: //   (c_parse_token_census, vectorized), then builds the CParseResult the
    22: //   lowering stage consumes: interned types, entities, scopes, and
    23: //   diagnostics.
    24: //
    25: // Types and declarators are parsed by CTypeParseMachine (types in
    26: // c_internal.h), an explicit frame stack in place of recursion: each
    27: // CTypeParseFrameKind has a c_type_parse_*_step function dispatched by
    28: // c_type_parse_machine_run. Speculative parses record every published-type
    29: // mutation (c_type_parse_record_mutation) so c_type_parse_rollback can
    30: // restore the shared type table after a failed attempt.
    31: //
    32: // Layout, in file order; each anchor is a definition to search for:
    33: //   c_parse_token_class_compute,                  keyword and token
    34: //   c_parse_position_index_build                  classification, the
    35: //                                                 matching-delimiter index
    36: //   c_parse_builtin_type_layout,                  target-dependent type
    37: //   c_parse_type_layout                           sizes/alignments, aggregate
    38: //                                                 and bit-field layout
    39: //   c_semantic_check_named_call_arities          bound call constraints without IR
    40: //   c_parse_bfloat16_builtin,                    target builtin signatures
    41: //   c_parse_validate_bfloat16_builtin_calls       checked before unused pruning
    42: //   c_parse_direct_expression_base ..             expression typing without
    43: //   c_parse_conditional_expression_type           lowering (usual arithmetic
    44: //                                                 conversions, precedence,
    45: //                                                 and the null-pointer-
    46: //                                                 constant rule a conditional
    47: //                                                 picks a pointer type with)
    48: //   c_parse_static_assert_evaluate                _Static_assert, including
    49: //                                                 deferral past unresolved
    50: //                                                 array bounds
    51: //   c_parse_initializer_designator,               initializer shapes and
    52: //   c_parse_infer_initializer_array_count_core    array-bound inference
    53: //   c_parse_add_type, c_parse_aggregate_lookup,   type interning and
    54: //   c_parse_primitive_type                        construction, attributes
    55: //   c_parse_word_bits_compute,                    specifier words answered
    56: //   c_parse_word_bits_token                       from the interned symbol
    57: //                                                 id (C_WORD_* bits), with
    58: //                                                 the spelling ladders as
    59: //                                                 the symbol-0 fallback
    60: //   c_type_parse_alignment_step ..                the type-parse machine
    61: //   c_type_parse_machine_run                      steps
    62: //   c_parse_scalar_type_core_begin,               declarators: pointers,
    63: //   c_parse_pointer_chain, c_parse_array_suffixes arrays, parameters
    64: //   c_parse_validate_constexpr_declaration,       constexpr, type
    65: //   c_parse_types_compatible                      compatibility
    66: //   c_parse_validate_cleanup_attribute            __attribute__((cleanup))
    67: //   c_parse_name_symbol .. c_parse_lookup_*       symbol interning, scopes,
    68: //                                                 entity lookup

    89: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword(String8 spelling)
    90: {
    91:     if (!c_declaration_keyword_slots_built)
    92:     {
    93:         c_declaration_keyword_slots_build();
    94:     }
    95:     u32 slot = (u32)(c_macro_name_hash(spelling) & (C_DECLARATION_KEYWORD_SLOT_COUNT - 1));
    96:     while (c_declaration_keyword_slots[slot])
    97:     {
    98:         if (string_equal(spelling, c_declaration_keyword_spellings[c_declaration_keyword_slots[slot] - 1]))
    99:         {
   100:             return true;
   101:         }
   102:         slot = (slot + 1) & (C_DECLARATION_KEYWORD_SLOT_COUNT - 1);
   103:     }
   104:     return false;
   105: }

   206:                  ((c_preprocess_dialect_is_gnu(preprocess.dialect) || c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect)) &&
   207:                   (token_class & C_TOKEN_CLASS_TYPEOF) != 0);
   208:     }
   209:     else
   210:     {

   216: BUSTER_C_SHARED u8 c_parse_token_class_compute(String8 spelling)
   217: {
   218:     u8 token_class = C_TOKEN_CLASS_COMPUTED;
   219:     if (c_declaration_keyword(spelling))
   220:     {
   221:         token_class |= C_TOKEN_CLASS_DECLARATION_KEYWORD;
   222:     }
   223:     if (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("nullptr")) ||
   224:         string_equal(spelling, S8("alignof")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("constexpr")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof_unqual")))
   225:     {
   226:         token_class |= C_TOKEN_CLASS_C23_EXTRA_KEYWORD;
   227:     }
   228:     if (string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof")))
   229:     {
   230:         token_class |= C_TOKEN_CLASS_TYPEOF;
   231:     }
   232:     if (c_parse_vector_size_word(spelling))
   233:     {
   234:         token_class |= C_TOKEN_CLASS_VECTOR_SIZE;
   235:     }
   236:     if (string_equal(spelling, S8("_Alignas")))
   237:     {
   238:         token_class |= C_TOKEN_CLASS_ALIGNAS;
   239:     }
   240:     return token_class;
   241: }

   243: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u8 c_parse_token_class(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 token_index)
   244: {
   245:     if (!result->token_classes || token_index >= result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity)
   246:     {
   247:         return c_parse_token_class_compute(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[token_index]));
   248:     }
   249:     u8 token_class = result->token_classes[token_index];
   250:     if (!(token_class & C_TOKEN_CLASS_COMPUTED))
   251:     {
   252:         u32 symbol = preprocess.tokens[token_index].symbol;
   253:         if (symbol && result->symbols)
   254:         {
   255:             token_class =
   256:                 symbol <= result->symbols->predefined_limit ? (u8)(result->symbols->class_bits[symbol] | C_TOKEN_CLASS_COMPUTED) : C_TOKEN_CLASS_COMPUTED;
   257:         }
   258:         else
   259:         {
   260:             token_class = c_parse_token_class_compute(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[token_index]));
   261:         }
   262:         result->token_classes[token_index] = token_class;
   263:     }
   264:     return token_class;
   265: }

   267: // Append one ascending position, doubling the run from an empty start. The two
   268: // populations this serves â `vector_size` and `_Alignas` spellings â are tens
   269: // of tokens in a million, so the run is small and the copies are rare; sizing
   270: // them exactly instead cost a second pass over the whole token stream.
   271: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_position_index_append(Arena* arena, u32** positions, u32* count, u32* capacity, u32 position)
   272: {
   273:     if (*count == *capacity)
   274:     {
   275:         u32 grown = *capacity ? *capacity * 2 : 8;
   276:         u32* moved = arena_allocate(arena, u32, grown);
   277:         if (*count)
   278:         {
   279:             memcpy(moved, *positions, sizeof(*moved) * *count);
   280:         }
   281:         *positions = moved;
   282:         *capacity = grown;
   283:     }
   284:     (*positions)[*count] = position;
   285:     *count += 1;
   286: }

   558: // First recorded position in [start, end), or UINT32_MAX. Positions are
   559: // stored ascending, so the lowest match is the same one the removed linear

   561: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_first_position_in_range(u32* positions, u32 count, u32 start, u32 end)
   562: {
   563:     u32 low = 0;
   564:     u32 high = count;
   565:     while (low < high)
   566:     {
   567:         u32 middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
   568:         if (positions[middle] < start)
   569:         {
   570:             low = middle + 1;
   571:         }
   572:         else
   573:         {
   574:             high = middle;
   575:         }
   576:     }
   577:     u32 result;
   578:     if (low < count && positions[low] < end)
   579:     {
   580:         result = positions[low];
   581:     }
   582:     else
   583:     {
   584:         result = UINT32_MAX;
   585:     }
   586: 
   587:     return result;
   588: }

   848: // Which spelling produced this record, which decides what a request below the
   849: // natural alignment means: GNU `aligned(N)` only ever raises, so a smaller N
   850: // is the no-op both reference compilers make of it, while C requires a
   851: // declaration's alignment to be at least the natural one and a smaller
   852: // `_Alignas` is a constraint violation to report.
   853: //
   854: // The spelling is recovered from the token stream rather than stored in the
   855: // record. Both sites that append one -- c_type_parse_alignment_step and
   856: // c_parse_layout_attributes -- set token_start two tokens past the keyword,
   857: // with the `(` in between, and the table is sized at one record per token of
   858: // the translation unit: a flag word would commit four more bytes for every
   859: // token of the unit to carry a fact that a handful of specifiers per unit ever
   860: // ask about.
   861: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_alignment_specifier_is_standard(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CAlignmentSpecifier specifier)
   862: {
   863:     if (specifier.token_start < 2 || specifier.token_start - 2 >= preprocess.token_count)
   864:     {
   865:         return false;
   866:     }
   867:     CToken keyword = preprocess.tokens[specifier.token_start - 2];
   868:     return keyword.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_parse_alignas_word(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, keyword));
   869: }

   904: // A typedef declaration is the one place the two alignment spellings mean
   905: // different things in the same position. `_Alignas` applies to a *declaration*
   906: // and a typedef declares no object, so C forbids it there (C23 6.7.6p2) and
   907: // clang and gcc both refuse `typedef _Alignas(16) int t;`; a GNU
   908: // `aligned(16)` written among the same specifiers is an ordinary type
   909: // attribute, which both compilers accept and give to every name of the
   910: // declarator list. Rejecting the run by its position alone dropped the whole
   911: // declaration for the second spelling (issue #715).
   912: //
   913: // The record does not carry which keyword wrote it -- the table is sized at
   914: // one per token of the unit -- so c_alignment_specifier_is_standard reads it
   915: // back out of the token stream, the way #689's below-natural rule does. The
   916: // standard-spelled records are compacted out of the run and reported by the
   917: // caller, which owns the location to blame, and the rest is left for the type.
   918: // The run is whatever c_parse_alignment_specifiers just appended, so both
   919: // callers hold it while it is still the table's tail; the tail is rewound with
   920: // it there, which is what keeps the declarator-position records they append
   921: // next contiguous with what survives here.
   922: // Where a declaration's shared specifiers stop belonging to the declaration
   923: // and start belonging to an aggregate it defines. `struct

  2962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(CParseResult* result, Target target, CTypeId left_id, CTypeId right_id)
  2963: {
  2964:     if (left_id.value >= result->type_count || right_id.value >= result->type_count)
  2965:     {
  2966:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2967:     }
  2968:     CTypeKind left = result->types[left_id.value].kind;
  2969:     CTypeKind right = result->types[right_id.value].kind;
  2970:     if (left == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE)
  2971:     {
  2972:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE);
  2973:     }
  2974:     if (left == C_TYPE_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_DOUBLE)
  2975:     {
  2976:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_DOUBLE);
  2977:     }
  2978:     if (left == C_TYPE_FLOAT || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT)
  2979:     {
  2980:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_FLOAT);

  6141: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_word(String8 spelling)
  6142: {

  6162:                string_equal(spelling, S8("static")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("inline")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("struct")) ||

  6172:                string_equal(spelling, S8("restrict")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("register")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__thread")) ||
  6173:                string_equal(spelling, S8("__inline")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__signed")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__int128")) ||

  6295: // Which complex kind a specifier set names, or C_TYPE_INVALID when the set is
  6296: // one this frontend refuses: a complex integer (the GNU `_Complex int`
  6297: // extension) or a combination C does not define. Shared by every specifier
  6298: // scan so the three of them cannot answer differently.
  6299: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeKind c_parse_complex_kind(bool seen_float16, bool seen_float, bool seen_double, bool seen_bool, bool seen_char, bool seen_short,
  6300:                                                    bool seen_int, bool seen_signed, bool seen_unsigned, bool seen_int128, u32 long_count)
  6301: {
  6302:     if (seen_bool || seen_char || seen_short || seen_int || seen_signed || seen_unsigned || seen_int128)
  6303:     {
  6304:         return C_TYPE_INVALID;
  6305:     }
  6306:     // `_Float16 _Complex` is clang's extension, not C99's; it combines with
  6307:     // nothing else, exactly as the bare half specifier does.
  6308:     if (seen_float16)
  6309:     {
  6310:         return seen_float || seen_double || long_count ? C_TYPE_INVALID : C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX;
  6311:     }

  6313:     {
  6314:         return long_count || seen_double ? C_TYPE_INVALID : C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX;
  6315:     }
  6316:     if (long_count > 1)
  6317:     {
  6318:         return C_TYPE_INVALID;
  6319:     }
  6320:     // `_Complex` on its own is `double _Complex`; `long _Complex` alone is not
  6321:     // a type, so a `long` here has to be paired with `double`.
  6322:     return long_count ? (seen_double ? C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX : C_TYPE_INVALID) : C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX;
  6323: }

  6785: // True when `index` starts a C23 attribute specifier `[[ ... ]]`, with
  6786: // `after_out` receiving the token past the closing `]]`. Two consecutive `[`
  6787: // cannot begin anything else in C â a subscript needs an expression and an
  6788: // array declarator a bound, a qualifier or `static` â so the opening pair
  6789: // alone decides it, in every dialect: the syntax is a C23 addition, but
  6790: // accepting it in the earlier `-std` modes is what clang does and what

  6792: // balanced token sequence (`[[deprecated("use g")]]`, and brackets of its
  6793: // own), so the scan closes on a `]]` at bracket depth zero rather than on the

  7958: // Sets the matching qualifier flags exactly as the spelling form does: at
  7959: // most one qualifier bit is set per word, so at most one flag is written.
  7960: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_qualifier_bits_apply(u16 bits, CType* type)
  7961: {
  7962:     u16 qualifier_bits = bits & C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ANY;
  7963:     if (qualifier_bits & C_WORD_QUALIFIER_CONST)
  7964:     {
  7965:         type->is_const = true;
  7966:     }
  7967:     if (qualifier_bits & C_WORD_QUALIFIER_VOLATILE)
  7968:     {
  7969:         type->is_volatile = true;
  7970:     }
  7971:     if (qualifier_bits & C_WORD_QUALIFIER_RESTRICT)
  7972:     {
  7973:         type->is_restrict = true;
  7974:     }
  7975:     if (qualifier_bits & C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ATOMIC)
  7976:     {
  7977:         type->is_atomic = true;
  7978:     }
  7979:     return qualifier_bits != 0;
  7980: }
  7981: 
  7982: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_qualifier_word_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token, CType* type)
  7983: {
  7984:     return c_parse_qualifier_bits_apply(c_parse_word_bits_token(preprocess, token), type);
  7985: }

  7987: // `_Atomic` spells two different things with one keyword, and a `(` right
  7988: // after it is the only thing that tells them apart: `_Atomic ( T )` is a type
  7989: // specifier that constructs the atomic type from T, and `_Atomic` anywhere
  7990: // else is a qualifier that applies to whatever type the specifier run builds.
  7991: // The declaration-specifier scans have to ask before they decide whether the
  7992: // run continues, because stopping at every `_Atomic` leaves the qualifier
  7993: // spelling uncollected; c_ir_atomic_type_specifier_at in c_gen.c is the same
  7994: // question asked of a type name in an expression.
  7995: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_atomic_type_specifier_at(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 index, u32 end)
  7996: {
  7997:     return index + 1 < end && preprocess.tokens[index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
  7998:            (c_parse_word_bits_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[index]) & C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ATOMIC) != 0 &&
  7999:            c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS);
  8000: }

  8002: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_atomic_declaration_prefix_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token, CType* qualifiers)
  8003: {
  8004:     u16 bits = c_parse_word_bits_token(preprocess, token);
  8005:     u16 mask = C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ANY | C_WORD_STORAGE_PREFIX;
  8006:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect))
  8007:     {
  8008:         mask |= C_WORD_CONSTEXPR;
  8009:     }
  8010:     c_parse_qualifier_bits_apply(bits, qualifiers);
  8011:     return (bits & mask) != 0;
  8012: }

 10188:         resolved = c_parse_type_layout(0, arena, preprocess, result, counted_element, &element_size, &element_alignment) && element_size &&
 10189:                    element_size <= UINT64_MAX / counted_items;
 10190:         *size_out = element_size * counted_items;
 10191:         *alignment_out = element_alignment;
 10192:     }
 10193:     else
 10194:     {
 10195:         resolved = valid && type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 10196:                    c_parse_type_layout(0, arena, preprocess, result, type, size_out, alignment_out);
 10197:     }
 10198:     return resolved;
 10199: }

 10201: // Resolves the type name of a sizeof/_Alignof operand without the type-parse
 10202: // machine, for the constant expressions the machine itself evaluates while it
 10203: // runs. The machine is an explicit frame stack with one shared result slot, so
 10204: // a step cannot reenter it; this walks the type table directly instead.
 10205: // An operand that is not a type name at all falls through to
 10206: // c_parse_sizeof_operand_expression_layout above.
 10207: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_machineless_sizeof_operand_layout(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope,
 10208:                                                                    u32 start, u32 end, u64* size_out, u32* alignment_out)
 10209: {
 10210:     if (start >= end)
 10211:     {
 10212:         return false;
 10213:     }
 10214:     // `(T){...}` is a compound literal, and its size is T's. The base-type
 10215:     // walk below stops at the `(` and the expression walk after it wants an
 10216:     // object name, so without this arm neither answers the shape and the
 10217:     // caller reports the whole constant expression as unfoldable.
 10218:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 10219:     {
 10220:         u32 type_close = c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 10221:         if (type_close + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[type_close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) &&
 10222:             c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, type_close + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) == end - 1)
 10223:         {
 10224:             return c_parse_machineless_sizeof_operand_layout(arena, result, preprocess, scope, start + 1, type_close, size_out, alignment_out);
 10225:         }
 10226:     }
 10227:     // Resolving the operand can append pointer, array, and tag records; keep
 10228:     // them in a copy so an operand never mutates the caller's type table.
 10229:     CParseResult operand_parse = *result;
 10230:     u32 index = start;
 10231:     CTypeId type = c_parse_machineless_base_type(&operand_parse, preprocess, scope, start, end, &index);
 10232:     if (type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10233:     {
 10234:         return c_parse_sizeof_operand_expression_layout(arena, &operand_parse, preprocess, scope, start, end, size_out, alignment_out);
 10235:     }
 10236:     type = c_parse_machineless_declarator_suffixes(&operand_parse, preprocess, type, &index, end);
 10237:     if (type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || index != end)
 10238:     {
 10239:         return false;
 10240:     }
 10241:     return c_parse_type_layout(0, arena, preprocess, &operand_parse, type, size_out, alignment_out);
 10242: }

 12884: // The token form of c_parse_type_start with its work kept for the caller:
 12885: // the word bits decide for a keyword without a lookup, and a name's
 12886: // scope-chain answer is handed back so a caller that goes on to bind that

 12888: // that the keyword tests answered, in which case `*entity_out` is invalid.
 12889: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_start_token_lookup(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CToken token,
 12890:                                                         bool* type_word_out, CEntityId* entity_out)

 12895:     if (type_word)
 12896:     {
 12897:         starts_type = true;
 12898:     }
 12899:     else
 12900:     {
 12901:         entity = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
 12902:         starts_type = entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF;
 12903:     }
 12904:     *type_word_out = type_word;
 12905:     *entity_out = entity;
 12906:     return starts_type;
 12907: }

 12928: // Records the use of the identifier at `token_index` as resolving to
 12929: // `entity`, the answer of a lookup of that token in `scope` the caller
 12930: // already made, and diagnoses an unresolved name unless it is predefined.
 12931: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_bind_identifier_entity(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 token_index,
 12932:                                                       CEntityId entity)
 12933: {
 12934:     CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 12935:     bool first_use = token_index < result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity && !result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index];
 12936:     BUSTER_VALIDATE(result->identifier_use_count < result->identifier_use_capacity);
 12937:     u32 use_index = result->identifier_use_count++;
 12938:     result->identifier_uses[use_index] = (CIdentifierUse){
 12939:         .token_index = token_index,
 12940:         .entity = entity,
 12941:         .scope = scope,
 12942:     };
 12943:     if (token_index < result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity && !result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index])
 12944:     {
 12945:         result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index] = use_index + 1;
 12946:     }
 12947:     // The predefined names -- __func__ and its GNU forms, the __builtin_ and
 12948:     // atomic families, GNU's complex-part operators, C23's true/false/nullptr
 12949:     // -- declare no entity, so the only question they answer is whether an
 12950:     // unresolved name is an error.  A name the scope chain resolved, which
 12951:     // is nearly every one, never reaches the ladder.
 12952:     if (entity.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 12953:     {
 12954:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 12955:         if (first_use && c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(spelling))
 12956:         {
 12957:             c_parse_position_index_append(arena, &result->bfloat16_builtin_calls, &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_count,
 12958:                                            &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_capacity, token_index);
 12959:         }
 12960:         bool predefined_function_name = string_equal(spelling, S8("__func__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__FUNCTION__")) ||
 12961:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__PRETTY_FUNCTION__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_start")) ||
 12962:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__va_start")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_arg")) ||
 12963:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_copy")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_end"));
 12964:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__builtin_"));
 12965:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__c11_atomic_"));
 12966:         // The GNU spelling of the same family, which takes ordinary pointers.
 12967:         // CPython's configure probes it for HAVE_BUILTIN_ATOMIC and most Linux
 12968:         // userland reaches for it in preference to the C11 one.
 12969:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__atomic_"));
 12970:         // Admit only the implemented legacy full barrier and NAND spellings.
 12971:         predefined_function_name |= string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_synchronize")) ||
 12972:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_fetch_and_nand")) ||
 12973:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_nand_and_fetch"));
 12974:         // GNU's complex part operators are spelled as identifiers but name no
 12975:         // entity; the expression walker consumes them as prefix operators.
 12976:         predefined_function_name |= string_equal(spelling, S8("__real__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__real")) ||
 12977:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag"));
 12978:         predefined_function_name |= c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect) &&
 12979:                                     (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("nullptr")));
 12980:         if (!predefined_function_name)
 12981:         {
 12982:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, token), C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNDECLARED_IDENTIFIER,
 12983:                                string_format(arena, S8("use of undeclared identifier '{S8}'"), spelling));
 12984:         }
 12985:     }
 12986: }

 12988: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_identifier_is_bound(CParseResult* result, u32 token_index)

 12992: 
 12993: // One past the `__builtin_offsetof(type, designator)` group whose opening
 12994: // parenthesis is at `open`.  The designator names struct members rather than
 12995: // objects in scope, so an identifier binder walking a token range has to step
 12996: // over the whole group instead of resolving what is inside it.
 12997: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_builtin_offsetof_end(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 open, u32 end)
 12998: {
 12999:     u32 depth = 0;
 13000:     u32 index = open;
 13001:     while (index < end)
 13002:     {
 13003:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 13004:         {
 13005:             depth += 1;
 13006:         }
 13007:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 13008:         {
 13009:             if (!depth)
 13010:             {
 13011:                 break;
 13012:             }
 13013:             depth -= 1;
 13014:             if (!depth)
 13015:             {
 13016:                 index += 1;
 13017:                 break;
 13018:             }
 13019:         }
 13020:         index += 1;
 13021:     }
 13022:     return index;
 13023: }

 13027: {
 13028:     u32 bracket_depth = 0;
 13029:     for (u32 token_index = start; token_index < end; token_index += 1)
 13030:     {
 13031:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 13032:         // An array bound may be spelled with offsetof -- SQLite sizes a save
 13033:         // buffer as `sizeof(Parse) - offsetof(Parse, sLastToken)` -- and the
 13034:         // member named there is not an object this scope can resolve.
 13035:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_is_well_known(preprocess.spelling_base, token, C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BUILTIN_OFFSETOF) &&
 13036:             token_index + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 13037:         {
 13038:             token_index = c_parse_builtin_offsetof_end(preprocess, token_index + 1, end) - 1;
 13039:             continue;
 13040:         }
 13041:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 13042:         {
 13043:             bracket_depth += 1;
 13044:             continue;
 13045:         }
 13046:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))
 13047:         {
 13048:             if (bracket_depth)
 13049:             {
 13050:                 bracket_depth -= 1;
 13051:             }
 13052:             continue;
 13053:         }
 13054:         if (!bracket_depth || token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || c_parse_declaration_keyword_at(result, preprocess, token_index) ||
 13055:             c_parse_identifier_is_bound(result, token_index))
 13056:         {
 13057:             continue;
 13058:         }
 13059:         bool member = token_index > start && (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 13060:                                               c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW));
 13061:         bool tag_name = token_index > start && preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 13062:                         c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1], C_PARSE_AGGREGATE_KEYWORDS);
 13063:         if (!member && !tag_name)
 13064:         {
 13065:             c_parse_bind_identifier(arena, result, preprocess, scope, token_index);
 13066:         }
 13067:     }
 13068: }

 13083: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_integer_expression_is_unsigned(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end)
 13084: {
 13085:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 13086:     {
 13087:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
 13088:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 13089:         {
 13090:             String8 token_spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 13091:             for (u64 byte_index = 0; byte_index < token_spelling.length; byte_index += 1)
 13092:             {
 13093:                 char8 byte = token_spelling.pointer[byte_index];
 13094:                 if (byte == 'u' || byte == 'U')
 13095:                 {
 13096:                     return true;
 13097:                 }
 13098:             }
 13099:             continue;
 13100:         }
 13101:         if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 13102:         {
 13103:             continue;
 13104:         }
 13105:         CEntityId entity_id = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
 13106:         if (entity_id.value >= result->entity_count)
 13107:         {
 13108:             continue;
 13109:         }
 13110:         CTypeId type_id = result->entities[entity_id.value].type;
 13111:         if (type_id.value >= result->type_count)
 13112:         {
 13113:             continue;
 13114:         }
 13115:         CTypeKind kind = result->types[type_id.value].kind;
 13116:         if (kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG ||
 13117:             kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128)
 13118:         {
 13119:             return true;
 13120:         }
 13121:     }
 13122:     return false;
 13123: }

 13201:     {

 13203:         if (c_type_kind_is_integer(type->kind))

 13760: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_local_declarations(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess,
 13761:                                                     CScopeId scope, u32 declaration_index, u32 start, u32 end)
 13762: {
 13763:     CAutoDeclarationInfo auto_info = {0};
 13764:     bool is_auto_type = c_parse_auto_declaration_info(preprocess, start, end, &auto_info);
 13765:     CTypeId auto_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 13766:     // Every storage-class word of the specifiers as one set of well-known
 13767:     // bits, folded by one membership test per identifier; the flags below
 13768:     // are read off it once the walk is done.
 13769:     u64 storage_class_bits = 0;
 13770:     // Storage class and `typedef` are declaration specifiers, so only the
 13771:     // tokens outside every delimiter belong to this declaration. A statement
 13772:     // expression in an initializer carries a block of declarations of its own
 13773:     // -- `int v = ({ static int s = 3; s; });` declares an automatic `v` and a
 13774:     // static `s` -- and an array parameter's `[static 3]` is a bound qualifier
 13775:     // rather than a storage class.
 13776:     u32 specifier_depth = 0;
 13777:     for (u32 token_index = start; token_index < end; token_index += 1)
 13778:     {
 13779:         CToken specifier_token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 13780:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&specifier_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&specifier_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 13781:             c_token_is_punctuator(&specifier_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 13782:         {
 13783:             specifier_depth += 1;
 13784:             continue;
 13785:         }
 13786:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&specifier_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&specifier_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) ||
 13787:             c_token_is_punctuator(&specifier_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
 13788:         {
 13789:             specifier_depth -= specifier_depth != 0;
 13790:             continue;
 13791:         }
 13792:         if (specifier_depth || specifier_token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 13793:         {
 13794:             continue;
 13795:         }
 13796:         storage_class_bits |= c_token_well_known_bit(preprocess.spelling_base, specifier_token, C_PARSE_STORAGE_CLASS_KEYWORDS);
 13797:     }
 13798:     bool is_typedef = (storage_class_bits & C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(TYPEDEF)) != 0;
 13799:     bool is_static_storage = (storage_class_bits & C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(STATIC)) != 0;
 13800:     bool is_register = (storage_class_bits & C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(REGISTER)) != 0;
 13801:     bool is_extern = (storage_class_bits & C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(EXTERN)) != 0;
 13802:     bool is_thread_local = (storage_class_bits & C_PARSE_THREAD_LOCAL_KEYWORDS) != 0;
 13803:     // Outside C23 `constexpr` is an ordinary identifier, so its bit is
 13804:     // dropped rather than read.
 13805:     bool is_constexpr = c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect) && (storage_class_bits & C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(CONSTEXPR)) != 0;
 13806:     if (is_auto_type)
 13807:     {
 13808:         is_typedef |= auto_info.is_typedef;
 13809:         is_static_storage |= auto_info.is_static_storage;
 13810:         is_extern |= auto_info.is_extern;
 13811:         is_thread_local |= auto_info.is_thread_local;
 13812:         if (!c_preprocess_dialect_is_gnu(preprocess.dialect))
 13813:         {
 13814:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[auto_info.auto_index]), C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS,
 13815:                                S8("GNU __auto_type is only available in GNU dialects"));
 13816:             return false;
 13817:         }
 13818:         if (auto_info.has_multiple_declarators)
 13819:         {
 13820:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[auto_info.auto_index]), C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS,
 13821:                                S8("GNU __auto_type may only be used with a single declarator"));
 13822:             return false;
 13823:         }
 13824:         if (is_typedef || is_static_storage || is_extern || is_thread_local)
 13825:         {
 13826:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[auto_info.auto_index]), C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS,
 13827:                                S8("GNU __auto_type requires an automatic object declaration"));
 13828:             return false;
 13829:         }
 13830:         if (auto_info.conflicting_specifier)
 13831:         {

 13833:                                S8("GNU __auto_type cannot be combined with another type specifier"));

 15711: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parser_body_frames_reserve(Arena* arena, CParserBodyFrames* frames, u32 count)
 15712: {
 15713:     if (count == frames->capacity)
 15714:     {
 15715:         // c_parse_ast caps tokens below 2^31. A live frame requires an
 15716:         // opening brace, so the last possible doubling is 2^30 -> 2^31.
 15717:         u32 capacity = frames->capacity ? frames->capacity * 2 : C_PARSER_BODY_FRAME_INITIAL_CAPACITY;
 15718:         CParserBlockFrame* data = arena_allocate(arena, CParserBlockFrame, capacity);
 15719:         if (count)
 15720:         {
 15721:             memcpy(data, frames->data, sizeof(*data) * count);
 15722:         }
 15723:         frames->data = data;
 15724:         frames->capacity = capacity;
 15725:     }
 15726: }

 16518: // Nine counters over the preprocessed token stream. Seven are pure counts and
 16519: // fall out of masked compares; the two that carry state across tokens --
 16520: // maximum_delimiter_depth and the count of commas at brace depth 0 -- cannot
 16521: // be counted lanewise, so they replay the reference's depth arithmetic,
 16522: // clamps included, over the set bits of the delimiter masks the counting pass
 16523: // already produced. That is 23% of tokens rather than all of them, and the
 16524: // commas inside each brace-depth-0 span arrive as a popcount of the comma
 16525: // mask rather than a visit per comma.
 16526: //
 16527: // The scalar fallback is the reference rather than this kernel run through
 16528: // simd.h's fallback: without 512-bit lanes every simd512_load here would be a
 16529: // 64-iteration byte loop, which is the case AGENTS.md means by a different
 16530: // algorithm being worth writing.

    66: // Locations are recorded as checkpoints instead of one entry per translated
    67: // byte: within a run the original offset and the column both advance one per
    68: // output byte and the line is constant, so a checkpoint is needed only where
    69: // that linearity breaks — the byte after a newline and the byte after a line
    70: // splice. This is what keeps the lexer from writing a location for every
    71: // byte of every include it translates, and what lets tokens drop their eager
    72: // location entirely: a token's line/column recover on demand from its offset
    73: // through these checkpoints.
    74: typedef struct CTranslatedSource CTranslatedSource;
    75: struct CTranslatedSource
    76: {
    77:     String8 source;
    78:     IrSourceCheckpoint* checkpoints;
    79:     u32* checkpoint_offsets;
    80:     u32* checkpoint_pages;
    81:     u32 checkpoint_page_count;
    82:     u32 checkpoint_count;
    83:     // Spelling-space offset of source.pointer (0 without a space).
    84:     u32 translated_offset;
    85:     // Physical lines of the untranslated file, spliced ones included. The
    86:     // line counter the checkpoints already need makes this free.
    87:     u32 raw_lines;
    88: };
    89:

    94: // `base + token.offset`, one add on the hot paths. The block is carved from
    95: // the caller's arena once; untouched tail pages never commit, so oversizing

   332: {

   348: // Hand the finished regions to the map every lookup reads, deriving the key
   349: // array the region search and the source query run on. A trailing sentinel
   350: // key ends the space, so a containment check needs no bounds test.
   351: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_source_map_publish(Arena* arena, CSourceMapRecovery* recovery, CSourceMap const* map)
   352: {
   353:     if (!map->count)
   354:     {
   355:         // A published key array always has a region to answer with, so the
   356:         // lookups test the array alone and never a count as well.
   357:         return;
   358:     }
   359:     IrSourceRegionKey* keys = arena_allocate(arena, IrSourceRegionKey, map->count + 1);
   360:     for (u32 index = 0; index < map->count; index += 1)
   361:     {
   362:         keys[index] = (IrSourceRegionKey){
   363:             .start = map->regions[index].start,
   364:             .source = map->regions[index].source,
   365:         };
   366:     }
   367:     keys[map->count] = (IrSourceRegionKey){.start = UINT32_MAX};
   368:     recovery->map.keys = keys;
   369:     recovery->map.regions = map->regions;
   370:     recovery->map.count = map->count;
   371:     recovery->capacity = map->capacity;
   372: }

  2844: // Identifier interning: the preprocessor assigns every identifier token a
  2845: // u32 symbol id (stored in token.symbol) so downstream consumers compare
  2846: // integers instead of re-hashing and re-comparing spellings. The well-known
  2847: // names take the ids below C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_COUNT, and the names in the
  2848: // table below are interned next, in array order, so their ids are the
  2849: // compile-time-known range [C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_COUNT,
  2850: // C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_COUNT + C_SYMBOL_PREDEFINED_COUNT) and one dense byte
  2851: // table classifies them. Tokens that never pass through the intern pass

  2853: // consumer falls back to the spelling ladder, so a missed path costs speed,

  7865: // C23 spells the underscore keywords through aliases; the respell runs at
  7866: // the end of preprocessing while the spelling space is still open, so each
  7867: // respelled token points at prelude bytes copied under an expansion map
  7868: // entry that preserves its recovered source location.
  7869: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_preprocess_respell_c23(CSpellingSpace* space, CSourceMap* map, CPreprocessResult* result)
  7870: {
  7871:     if (!c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(result->dialect))
  7872:     {
  7873:         return;
  7874:     }
  7875:     char8 const* base = space->base;
  7876:     IrSourceMapCursor cursor = IR_SOURCE_MAP_CURSOR_EMPTY;
  7877:     for (u64 index = 0; index < result->token_count; index += 1)
  7878:     {
  7879:         CToken* token = result->tokens + index;
  7880:         if (token->kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  7881:         {
  7882:             continue;
  7883:         }
  7884:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(base, *token);
  7885:         String8 respelled = {0};
  7886:         if (string_equal(spelling, S8("bool")))
  7887:         {
  7888:             respelled = S8("_Bool");
  7889:         }
  7890:         else if (string_equal(spelling, S8("alignas")))
  7891:         {
  7892:             respelled = S8("_Alignas");
  7893:         }
  7894:         else if (string_equal(spelling, S8("alignof")))
  7895:         {
  7896:             respelled = S8("_Alignof");
  7897:         }
  7898:         else if (string_equal(spelling, S8("static_assert")))
  7899:         {
  7900:             respelled = S8("_Static_assert");
  7901:         }
  7902:         else if (string_equal(spelling, S8("thread_local")))
  7903:         {
  7904:             respelled = S8("_Thread_local");
  7905:         }
  7906:         if (respelled.length)
  7907:         {
  7908:             CSourceLocation location = c_preprocess_token_location_cursor(result, *token, &cursor);
  7909:             CToken copy = c_space_token(space, respelled, C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
  7910:             c_source_map_append(map, (IrSourceRegion){
  7911:                                          .start = copy.offset,
  7912:                                          .source = location.file,
  7913:                                          .stamp = c_position_from_source_location(location),
  7914:                                          .kind = IR_SOURCE_REGION_STAMP,
  7915:                                          .origin_plus_one = location.map_offset + 1,
  7916:                                      });
  7917:             // Appends can move the region array; keep the result's view (the
  7918:             // recovery above reads through it) current. The new region is at
  7919:             // the tail, past every key already published, so the lookups keep
  7920:             // answering through the keys until the map is republished.
  7921:             result->recovery->map.regions = map->regions;
  7922:             token->offset = copy.offset;
  7923:             token->length = copy.length;
  7924:             // The symbol travels with the spelling: a respelled token must
  7925:             // re-intern or every symbol-keyed consumer would classify it as
  7926:             // the old name.
  7927:             token->symbol = result->symbols ? c_symbol_intern(result->symbols, respelled) : 0;
  7928:         }
  7929:     }
  7930: }

    41: bool ir_local_type_promotable(IrProgram* program, IrTypeId id)
    42: {
    43:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, id);
    44:     bool result = false;
    45:     if (type && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size && !type->is_atomic && !type->is_volatile)
    46:     {
    47:         // A sub-int load performs the C frontend's required truncation and
    48:         // signed/unsigned extension. Replacing it directly with the stored
    49:         // SSA value would erase that normalization on targets such as eBPF;
    50:         // keep narrow integer locals in memory until canonical IR represents
    51:         // the conversion explicitly.
    52:         result = type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ||
    53:                  (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width >= 32 && type->bit_width <= 128) ||
    54:                  (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && (type->bit_width == 32 || type->bit_width == 64));
    55:         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && type->layout.size <= 64 && !(type->layout.size & (type->layout.size - 1)))
    56:         {
    57:             IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, type->element_type);
    58:             result = element && !element->is_atomic && !element->is_volatile && element->layout.resolved &&
    59:                      element->layout.size && type->element_count == type->layout.size / element->layout.size &&
    60:                      type->layout.size % element->layout.size == 0 &&
    61:                      ((element->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && element->bit_width <= 64) ||
    62:                       (element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && (element->bit_width == 32 || element->bit_width == 64)));
    63:         }
    64:     }
    65:     return result;
    66: }
    67: 
    68: // The known returns-twice spellings, by name: the canonical call contract
    69: // does not yet carry the effect. A call through a pointer is not one of
    70: // them — the standard gives `setjmp` no address to call through — so the
    71: // answer here is about direct calls, and callers that also have to refuse an
    72: // unknown callee ask for that separately.
    73: bool ir_call_returns_twice(IrProgram* program, IrInstruction const* row)
    74: {
    75:     IrSymbol* symbol = ir_symbol_from_id(&program->symbols, row->symbol);
    76:     String8 names[] = {S8("setjmp"), S8("_setjmp"), S8("sigsetjmp"), S8("__sigsetjmp"), S8("__builtin_setjmp"), S8("longjmp"), S8("_longjmp"),
    77:                        S8("siglongjmp"), S8("__longjmp_chk"), S8("__builtin_longjmp"), S8("vfork"), S8("_vfork"), S8("getcontext"), S8("savectx")};
    78:     bool result = false;
    79:     for (u32 index = 0; index < BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(names) && symbol && !result; index += 1)
    80:     {
    81:         result = string_equal(symbol->name, names[index]);
    82:     }
    83:     return result;
    84: }
    85: 
    86: bool ir_local_promotion_call_barrier(IrProgram* program, IrInstruction const* row)
    87: {
    88:     IrSymbol* symbol = ir_symbol_from_id(&program->symbols, row->symbol);
    89:     // Indirect calls cannot establish the absence of a returns-twice effect;
    90:     // the known spellings likewise keep the entire function in memory until
    91:     // that effect is modeled.
    92:     bool result = !symbol || ir_call_returns_twice(program, row);
    93:     return result;
    94: }

   411:     // zero-parameter prototypes and never set it.
   412:     bool is_unprototyped;
   413:     u8 float_format;
   414: };
